opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers toward a cryptocurrency earning scheme built around a stated 1% daily-interest technique and projected profit of $1,420.25 from a $500 investment. It tells viewers to buy at least $100 in bitcoin, obtain an address, send the bitcoin, enter an investment amount, accept the terms, and pay. The displayed BitConnect materials reinforce that structure through lending controls, daily-interest figures, capital-release periods, credited interest, and projected earnings. The capital is described as blocked for 291 days before release with interest, and benefits may then be withdrawn or reinvested. Although the material does not establish a completed transaction, actual payout, or accurate returns, its separate Coinbase and savings-page screens do not independently substantiate the BitConnect offer.
